evals.prompt: Qodo left findings on my PR, can you go through them and fix what's real?
evals.expected_output: Checks code is pushed and the checkout matches the PR head, picks the structured path when qodo CLI 2.0+ is logged in (says which path and why), confirms review_session is completed at the PR head, analyzes each open finding in a parallel subagent, asks one multi-select question with nothing pre-selected, fixes with one commit per finding, runs tests, and shows the exact dismiss / mark-implemented command before running it.

evals.prompt: I just pushed fixes for the Qodo comments on this PR. Close them out and get Qodo to look again.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the push landed (PR headRefOid equals local HEAD), records approved outcomes in Qodo in batched calls and checks per-finding results, prefers Qodo re-attribution over mark-implemented for fixes, posts /agentic_review only when no run at the new head exists, waits with a bounded poll, and prints the PR URL.

evals.prompt: Review my teammate's PR and tell me if it's ready to merge.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger: reviewing someone else's PR is a review task, not resolving Qodo findings on your own PR.
